name: ECC
description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
one_liner: A toolkit that makes AI coding assistants remember past sessions, follow safer habits, and work faster — like giving your coding AI a persistent memory and a set of good work habits.
buyer: An engineering manager at a startup whose team leans heavily on AI coding agents and wants those agents to stop re-explaining context every session and to follow consistent security practices.
business_use_cases: A small dev shop installs it across every client project so their AI agents remember each codebase's conventions between sessions instead of relearning it daily.
A solo SaaS founder uses the memory feature so their coding agent picks up exactly where it left off after a multi-day feature build, without re-explaining the architecture.
A security-conscious agency pays for the Pro/GitHub App tier to get the built-in security scanning of agent-written code before it merges.

money_ideas.idea: This project already runs a paid tier itself — private-repo access from $19/seat/month — proving the model: sell memory/security add-ons for AI coding agents to teams.
Offer paid onboarding/setup consulting for engineering teams who want it wired into their CI and multiple agent harnesses correctly.

steal_this: Not much to build from scratch here — the fastest move is to just install and use it, or study its paid-tier pricing page as a template for monetizing your own dev-tool skill.
